name: Fatherhood
overview: Scripture presents fatherhood as a divine calling rooted in God's own example of care and instruction. Fathers are entrusted to lead their households in the ways of the Lord, teaching justice, judgment, and godly understanding as Abraham did (Genesis 18:19; Proverbs 4:1). The Lord’s compassionate care for His children models how earthly fathers should nurture and discipline, reflecting both tender pity and necessary correction (Psalms 103:13; Proverbs 3:11). Moreover, children are portrayed as a precious heritage and reward from the Lord, underscoring the sacred responsibility of fatherhood (Psalms 127:3; Psalms 78:5).
